Interface MemberAssignmentState

@Public @Evolving public interface MemberAssignmentState
The active, standby, and warm-up tasks that a streams group member currently has, used by the TaskAssignor to compute a new target assignment.

All maps returned by this interface, including their nested collections, are unmodifiable.
